Infernus.why: Infernus holds a huge 35.3% pick rate on a 47.7% WR: a comfort staple, not a killer. Dashfernus (spirit dash) is his stronger, untouched line, while the 09-16 Spiritual Overflow nerf stripped the capstone from his burn-gun build, widening the gap between his two identities in a meta that rewards mobility over late scaling.
enabled_by: Spirit scaling — Escalating Exposure 54.0% WR leads (Spiritual Overflow nerfed 09-16)
09-16 dash no longer breaking gun cycle time

builds.name: Dashfernus (spirit dash)
builds.notes: Full-spirit mobility build: Flame Dash to kite and re-engage, burn + Mystic Vulnerability/Escalating Exposure for damage; posts the higher win rates of his two builds and is untouched by 09-16.

builds.name: Burn gun carry
builds.notes: Gun build leaning on burn via Toxic Bullets; Spiritual Overflow was nerfed 09-16 (spirit 40->30, fire rate 30->25%, slower buildup) so it is dropped for Swift Striker/Titanic Magazine — still his weaker-performing item set.

Infernus.notes:
09-16 (indirect): Spiritual Overflow nerfed (40->30 spirit, 30->25% fire rate) — burn gun build drops it for Toxic Bullets/Swift Striker; Dashfernus untouched.
Correction accepted: not a pure gun hero — data agrees (spirit items lead on both share and WR), so both builds kept; spirit build edges out gun. Low confidence on matchups (samples 150-350 games) and on any post-patch shift, since the 47.7%/35.3% snapshot is pre-09-16.

Seven.notes:
09-16 (indirect): Cultist Sacrifice bounty 180->170% trims his farm-banker opener.
Changelog: 09-16 tempo patch (comeback souls cut, early Rift resist now 10%+1%/min, +3s respawn at 20m) hurts farm-first scalers.

Vindicta.why: Poke/siege carry the tempo economy wants, but the anti-flyer patch taxes her the same way: air-drag slows and Silver's Weighted Bola ground Flight, cutting the uptime that converts a won lane. 37.8% PR keeps her ubiquitous, but 50.3% WR says she isn't free wins — a mid-tier pick now, not the S the tempo read implies.
Vindicta.notes:
09-16 (indirect): global slows now bite air drag and Silver's Weighted Bola grounds Flight — anti-flyer tax drops her to B; no line helps a poke carry in a tempo meta.
heresy's 09-17 ricochet/split-shot ult buff is unattributable; the 09-16 notes give it to Venator — treat as uncertain.

Lady Geist.notes:
09-16: Life Drain T3 spirit scaling 0.3->0.45 and Essence Bomb T3 26->30% buff her bomb/drain, but Radiant Regeneration 2->1.7 per-boon trims her 98%-buy regen core.
Radiant Regeneration nerf plus the comeback rework gutting her 0-6-then-farm pattern are what cap this rise, so I weight it below the creators' 'rising'.
WR 46.6% / PR 14.4% is a 14-day pre-patch snapshot; creator reads are A but direction is split (vegas stable, heresy rising).

enabled_by: gun-cycle change (dashes/light melee no longer break gun cycle)

Wraith.why: Wraith's spirit on-hit identity was deleted by 09-16: Card Trick heal/scaling/resist/slow cuts plus the Mercurial Magnum nerf and Plated Armor's on-hit fix (which now blanks Full Auto's spirit damage) leave her a pure-gun carry. She keeps a high floor (~51% WR, near-50% PR) as a fire-rate M1/AoE-delete, but is outclassed in her slot by tempo carries (Silver, Venator, Haze) and punished by the dive the meta rewards.

builds.name: Gun carry (pure gun)
builds.notes: Post-09-16 rebuild: the Mercurial Magnum / on-hit-spirit package is dead (Magnum base 25->20% and scaling 0.49->0.38, Spiritual Overflow nerfed, Plated Armor now blanks Full Auto's spirit damage), so stack fire rate and gun damage instead of spirit procs; Quicksilver Reload (100% share) is still the signature early buy and Ricochet still turns her into an AoE-delete.

builds.name: Sustain gun
builds.notes: Fire-rate gun line with Dispel Magic (85%) and Spirit Lifesteal (53% item WR) to survive being focused; take it when you're the dive target, not when you're free-hitting.

Wraith.notes:
09-16: Card Trick heal 75->60, heal scaling 0.75->0.5, resist shred -8->-7% (T3 -5->-4%), T3 slow +20->+15%; Mercurial Magnum + Spiritual Overflow gutted and Plated Armor now blanks Full Auto spirit damage — on-hit-spirit core abandoned, rebuild pure gun.
Creator-cited Capacitor/Slowing Hex appear in none of the top-15 item slots; usage says the real core was spirit on-hit (Quicksilver Reload 100%, Mercurial Magnum 93%) — Magnum now dead.
Build clustering is medium-confidence: inferred from shares/buy_min, no ability text.

Paradox.why: Pick/sniper whose identity narrowed further by 09-16: the Kinetic Carbine min-damage quick-scope (25->10%, no longer T3-scaled) is gone, so only the max-range HVR/Sharpshooter path converts. A 47.5% WR on a 44% PR means the pick fantasy stays popular even as the stationary sniper folds to the tempo meta's mobile divers (Yamato, Lash, Holliday).

Dynamo.notes:
09-16 (indirect): Diviner's Kevlar gained +10% ultimate CDR — now a live buy for his Refresher/Singularity plan.
Newest creator note (07-16) rates him B, but the 09-16 tempo patch plus 52.1% WR / 27% PR supports A-rising; I follow the data. Matchup samples are moderate (~180-320) and the WR snapshot predates 09-16, so post-patch numbers could move.
Build read is spirit-spine with a Refresher late spike; Headshot Booster (50%, 2.6 min) is just a starting item, not a gun build.
